<DOCSTRING>Summary: Implements a mixin to freeze time in tests, ensuring consistent test environments.

Description: This mixin is used within test fixtures to create a consistent test environment by freezing time at a specific point. It is instantiated within test cases to ensure that time-related operations are predictable and do not change during the test execution. The `freeze` fixture sets up a test environment where time is fixed at the specified datetime, allowing for reliable and repeatable tests.

Attributes:
    ts (datetime): The specific datetime at which time is frozen. This is set during the instantiation of the fixture and used to create a consistent test environment.</DOCSTRING>
